title: Investec’s ongoing PBSA engagement
summary: Investec Bank continues to be a significant PBSA lender in the UK, with recent facilities such as a £26 million senior loan to a Moorfield PBSA development in Bristol. Over the longer term, Investec has originated more than £1.15 billion in PBSA lending since 2011, backing dozens of schemes and thousands of student beds across multiple UK cities.
